thread:
rachel: Heads-up: dark-launch of the new capacity-rebalance engine this Sunday 02:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: validate graceful preempt & rebalancer handoff under realistic traffic. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cap-rebalance-darklaunch (ID RW-CR-2025)

rachel: High-level: we'll enable rebalancer in observation mode for 10m, then flip to soft-enforce for 30m on a subset of clusters (prod-edge-1, prod-edge-2). Expect transient p50/p95 changes, potential +10% token-cost variance for brief periods.

priya: product note: no external customer notice. We'll create a short post to eng-all after completion summarizing metrics. If user-facing errors >0.3% or sustained p99 >150ms for >7m, we abort.

tom: infra: steps

```
infra-cli tag-cluster --cluster prod-edge-1 --tag rebalance-dark
infra-cli rebalancer set-mode --clusters prod-edge-1,prod-edge-2 --mode observe --window 10m
infra-cli rebalancer set-mode --clusters prod-edge-1,prod-edge-2 --mode soft-enforce --window 30m
```

tom: we'll warm up KV cache prefixes for the big-model routes before flipping to soft-enforce. Also pre-allocating a small eviction reserve so hot shards aren't moved too aggressively.

zack: oncall ack. I'll watch error budget and token-cost dashboards. Pager policy: if 5xx >0.2% for 5m or p99 >200ms for 10m -> escalate.

slo-bot: NOTICE: Temporary SLO suppression applied for route=embeddings-index p99 +30ms from 2390011111 to 2390011845 (reason: capacity rebalance dark-launch). Suppress alerts only, metrics still recorded.

priya: product question: do we need a fallback model routing policy change?

tom: no change to model routing. Rebalancer will prefer preserving QoS buckets. Soft-enforce means it will avoid moving nodes with active premium sessions.

rachel: rollback criteria (quick list):
- 5xx spike >0.3% sustained 5m
- user-facing latency p99 >200ms for 7m
- >25% drop in request throughput for any route for 10m
If any trigger hits, runbook has automated revert: `infra-cli rebalancer set-mode --clusters <list> --mode off`

zack: I'll call abort if criteria hit and post cause. Team please confirm you can run the revert command.

priya: confirmed. DevEx, please check SDK reconnect/backoff handling during soft-enforce.

rachel: deploy-bot: preflight check started.

deploy-bot: preflight: capacity checks OK; KV warmup queued; smoke tests scheduled at T+5m.

pager-bot: Reminder scheduled: capacity-rebalance dark-launch in 48h (2390179911).

tom: post-run artifacts we want:
- trace sample set tagged X-RW-Rebalance=dark
- token-cost delta per-route
- node-move histogram
- SLO regression summary
Please upload to runbook within 12h.

rachel: thanks all. If everyone is good, we'll proceed. I'll drop a final checklist tomorrow AM with exact cluster node IDs and revert commands. :white_check_mark:
